name: Javier Mateo
psychographics: Pragmatic about efficiency; balances traditional farming methods with tools that genuinely save time during planting season.
current_solutions: Uses a WhatsApp group with other local farmers to coordinate seed purchases; orders tractor parts from an online Hungarian distributor; watches YouTube tutorials for equipment repair.
frustration: Attempted to upload a 2GB drone mapping file at 9:40 PM to check crop health, but the upload stalled at 12% due to the ISP's 10 PM throttling limit, forcing him to wait until morning.
decision_style: Compares specs on forums; often buys mid-range tools that offer the best price-to-performance ratio rather than the cheapest option.
voice: Direct and professional, switches to rapid Hungarian technical jargon when discussing machinery, then back to English for general chat.
